svg.metadata: Target and surrounding national geometry: Natural Earth 1:10m cultural vectors, WGS84, public domain, via LonnyGomes/CountryGeoJSONCollection (VEN/COL/BRA/GUY/TTO/GRD GeoJSON). Shared JOURNEY ATLAS map-v3 clean-background styling is used for sea, context land, target land, stroke and shadow. Natural Earth de facto administrative depiction is used without taking a position on the Venezuela–Guyana territorial dispute. Cayo de Agua is below reliable national-scale coastline resolution and is represented at its verified Scene coordinate within the canonical target-land path. Generated 2026-09-26.
